newsitem.title: USA: Mohave 750 MW coal-fired unit at 90 MW and rising.
newsitem.headline: Mohave 750 MW coal-fired unit at 90 MW and rising.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Mohave coal-fired power plant near Laughlin, Nev., was at 90 MW early Wednesday morning after boilers were brought back on-line late Tuesday, a plant spokesman said.
The unit was expected to reach full power in six to eight hours, he noted.
The unit was taken off-line late Saturday due to a boiler tube leak.
Mohave's other 750 MW unit was said to be operating at normal rates.
Southern California Edison Co is the majority owner and operator of the Mohave units.
